games.title: Beat Tap
games.description: Tap the lanes in time with the falling notes and keep your combo alive.

games.title: Drift Dash
games.description: Drag to steer, grab the coins and dodge the blocks. Hold for a shield.

games.title: Lights Out
games.description: Tap a light to flip it and its neighbours. Turn them all off to win.

games.title: Memory Flash
games.description: Watch the pads light up, then repeat the pattern. Three rounds, each one longer.

games.title: Pop Rush
games.description: Tap the targets before they fade. Clear 12 pops in 15 seconds; hold for a bomb.
